answer: New keys must earn standing through elapsed time, not fees. During probation each identity answers liveness beacons with verifiable-delay proofs: outputs that need long sequential computation, so they cannot be parallelized across a rack or bought from a market. A comet's tail of fresh clones still trails one core, yet every key must finish its own delay chain in wall-clock time; a farmer minting N identities pays N simultaneous months. Prism-like timing jitter re-checks proofs and exposes precomputed ones. Standing accretes like a pearl, and no warehouse can shortcut the calendar.
